hint.text: The Middle Ages was a period of time in Europe that began in the year 500 and lasted until the year 1500.
hint.label: Middle Ages

feedback.end: In the Middle Ages, people played different sports depending on their status. Society was divided into the king and his knights, who owned lots of land and money, and the poor peasants who worked for them.

instruction.text: Select the correct characters in the field to learn more.

feedback.correct: Archery was very popular and an important fighting skill, as men needed to be ready for war. Knights would often take part in tournaments to practise.
Jousting was a very dangerous sport. Knights would charge at each other on horses and try to knock their opponent off using a long stick called a lance.
Melee was also popular with knights across Britain. It involved groups of men fighting in fake battles, but people still often got injured and even died!

instruction.text: A king is talking to one of his lords. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Soon, I will go to ((++war school)) and I need peasants from your land for my army.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>Soon, I will go to war and I need peasants from your land for my army.</prosody>

atoms.b: Certainly Sire, how many ((children ++men)) do you need?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>Certainly, Sire — how many men do you need?</prosody>

atoms.b: As many as you have! I expect them to be well-trained and ((scared ++ready)) to fight!
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>As many as you have! I expect them to be well-trained and ready to fight!</prosody>

atoms.b: What would you like them to ((buy ++practise))?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>What would you like them to practise?</prosody>

atoms.b: I need them to be fit and healthy. They will need to know how to use a ((++sword knife)) and shield and shoot a bow and ((carrot ++arrow)).
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>I need them to be fit and healthy. They will need to know how to use a sword and shield, and shoot a bow and arrow.</prosody>

atoms.b: Of course, it will be done.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>Of course — it will be done.</prosody>

atoms.b: Just like knights, peasants also fought in ((++wars supermarkets)), so sports like wrestling, ((cow ++horse)) riding and sword ((writing ++fighting)) helped them get better prepared.

Archery was considered one of the most ((boring ++important)) sports. During the Middle Ages, laws were introduced that ((++forced stopped)) all men between 15 and 60 to own a bow and be able to shoot it.
Peasants also commonly played ((++safer more_dangerous)) games such as bowls, skittles and boardgames to relax and socialise.

instruction.text: Which sport do you think is from the Middle Ages?

feedback.finish: That’s right! Mob football was a rough, chaotic sport played by peasants using a ball made from a stuffed pigs’ bladder. Teams could have unlimited players and the only official rule was no murder!
